accountAccess.question: How do I access my account?
accountAccess.answer: Sign in with the email you used to register. If you run into issues, reset your password from the login page or reach out to support.

inviteTeam.question: Can I invite my teammates?
inviteTeam.answer: Yes. Open your workspace settings, choose "Members," and send invitations by email to collaborate instantly.

getSupport.question: Where can I get more help?
getSupport.answer: Browse the guides above for step-by-step tutorials or contact us directly and we will follow up with tailored assistance.

automationTemplates.question: How do I enable the new automation templates?
automationTemplates.answer: Open the Automation Library from the Help Center, choose a recipe, and map each step to the integrations connected to your workspace.

mobileAccess.question: Is there a mobile experience?
mobileAccess.answer: Yes. Install the iOS or Android app to receive push notifications, approve workflows, and chat with teammates on the go.

billing.question: Where can I manage billing settings?

about.title: About Bro World
about.subtitle: Explore the feature-rich platform that powers Bro World across teams, products, and communities.
about.intro: Bro World has grown into a unified digital workspace that merges community, content publishing, messaging, and automation in one cohesive experience.
about.mission: Our mission is to help teams prototype quickly, launch faster, and manage daily operations with confidence through modular building blocks.
about.vision: From AI-assisted workflows to real-time collaboration dashboards, every feature is designed to stay adaptable as your organization evolves.

frontend.title: Frontend experience
frontend.description: Nuxt 3, Vue 3, TypeScript, and Vuetify 3 power an accessible interface with micro-frontends, offline caching, and responsive design that feels fast on every device.

backend.title: Backend foundation
backend.description: Node.js services orchestrate queues, WebSockets, search indexing, and PostgreSQL persistence behind the scenes.

api.title: Symfony microservices
api.description: Decoupled Symfony API microservices expose secure REST and GraphQL endpoints along with turnkey integrations and webhooks.

realtime.title: Real-time collaboration
realtime.description: Live presence, shared commenting, and WebSocket events keep teams aligned as updates roll out in seconds.

automation.title: Automation & intelligence
automation.description: Background jobs, AI assistants, and scheduled workflows eliminate repetitive work and surface next-best actions.

devops.title: DevOps & security
devops.description: Infrastructure-as-code pipelines, containerized deployments, and continuous security scanning protect every release.

collaboration.title: Workspace collaboration
collaboration.description: Multi-tenant workspaces, role-based permissions, and shared calendars support distributed teams.

analytics.title: Actionable analytics
analytics.description: Interactive dashboards, exportable reports, and unified metrics reveal product health in seconds.

customization.title: Deep customization
customization.description: Theme builder, extension hooks, and granular settings let you adapt every surface to your brand.

marketplace.title: Ecosystem marketplace
marketplace.description: Curated plugins, integration kits, and open APIs accelerate new feature delivery.

callToAction.title: Build with Bro World
callToAction.description: Ready to extend the platform or connect your stack? Reach out and let's blueprint the next generation of features together.

education.In order to enable the automatic version: In order to enable the automatic version checking you have to register your portal on chamilo.org. The information obtained by clicking this button is only for internal use and only aggregated data will be publicly available (total number of portals, total number of Chamilo course, total number of Chamilo users, ...) (see {0}). When registering you will also appear on the worldwide list ({1}). If you do not want to appear in this list you have to check the checkbox below. The registration is as easy as it can be: you only have to click this button:
education.To protect your site, make the whole %s: To protect your site, make the whole {0} directory read-only (chmod -R 0555 on Linux) and delete the {1} directory.
education.Cannot find your language in the list? C: Cannot find your language in the list? Contact us at info@chamilo.org to contribute as a translator.
education.Please read the following requirements t: Please read the following requirements thoroughly.
education.Recommended settings for your server con: Recommended settings for your server configuration. These settings are set in the php.ini configuration file on your server.
education.Chamilo is free software distributed und: Chamilo is free software distributed under the GNU General Public licence (GPL).
education.The install script will create (or use): The install script will create (or use) the Chamilo database using the database name given here. Please make sure the user you give has the right to create the database by the name given here. If a database with this name exists, it will be overwritten. Please do not use the root user as the Chamilo database user. This can lead to serious security issues.
education.The install script will erase all tables: The install script will erase all tables of the selected database. We heavily recommend you do a full backup of them before confirming this last install step.

education.This icon will show for the link display: This icon will show for the link displayed as a tool on the course homepage.
education.The database connection has failed. This: The database connection has failed. This is generally due to the wrong user, the wrong password or the wrong database prefix being set above. Please review these settings and try again.
Go to your newly created portal.
education.The DSN fully includes all parameters ne: The DSN fully includes all parameters needed to connect to the mail service. You can learn more at {0}. The default value is null://null and will disable e-mail sending. Use native://default to use the default PHP configuration on your server. Here are a few examples of supported DSN syntaxes: {1}.
education.The e-mail address from which e-mails wi: The e-mail address from which e-mails will be sent when the platform sends an e-mail, also used as 'reply-to' header. We recommend using a 'no-reply' e-mail address here, to avoid excessive filling of an e-mail box. The support e-mail address defined in the Platform section should be used to contact you, but replying to automatic notifications should not be encouraged.
education.The name that appears as the sender (nex: The name that appears as the sender (next to the From e-mail address) when the platform sends an e-mail.
education.Some directories and the files they incl: Some directories and the files they include must be writable by the web server in order for Chamilo to run (user uploaded files, homepage html files, ...). This might imply a manual change on your server (outside of this interface).
education.A database with the same name already ex: A database with the same name already exists. It will be deleted.
education.When you enter your portal for the first: When you enter your portal for the first time, the best way to understand it is to create a course with the 'Create course' link in the menu and play around a little.
education.You are about to start using one of the: You are about to start using one of the best Open Source e-learning platforms on the market. Like many other Open Source projects, Chamilo is backed up by a large community of students, teachers, developers, content creators and businesses who would like to promote the project better.
education.By knowing a little bit more about you,: By knowing a little bit more about you, a platform administrator, one of the most important user type for us, who will manage this e-learning system, we will be able to let people know, statistically, how our software is used while respecting your privacy. We will also be able to let you know when we organize events that might be relevant to you or offer additional services that might be of value to your organisation.
education.By filling this form, you agree that the: By filling this form, you agree that the editor of Chamilo, the {0} company, registered in Belgium, and/or members of its network of partners (exclusively Chamilo services providers) might occasionally send you information by e-mail about important events or updates in the Chamilo software or community. This will help the community grow as an organized entity where information flows, with a thorough respect of your time and your privacy.
education.Please note that you are NOT REQUIRED to: Please note that you are NOT REQUIRED to fill this form. If you want to remain anonymous, we will lose the opportunity to offer you all the privileges of being a registered portal administrator, but we will respect your decision. Simply leave this form empty and click Next.
